data.scope: Two independent mixed roots under one fixed assignment; this is recursive aggregation qualification.
data.timing_boundary: Fleet execution includes launch, fixture copy, fresh proving, CPU audits, telemetry and cleanup. Registry preparation, wallet proving and durable application are excluded.

data.change: Resolve pinned shared assignments and validate automatically assigned budgets consistently across admission, attempt and result records. Proof binaries unchanged.

limitations: Count four only; the remaining mixed counts need real roots.
These are independent roots on two GPUs, not one root distributed across GPUs.
Wallet proving, registry preparation and durable host application are outside the timing boundary.
The 600-second cold full64, 180-second complete post-seal and four-wallet pilot gates remain open.
scope: Five alternating sequential/concurrent paired count-four comparisons. One independent root per GPU.
